user.title: Sorgenia login
user.description: Enter your Sorgenia email and the value of the password field in the POST /sorgenia/V5/login Network payload. If it differs from the password typed on the website, use the payload value. API settings are read from /config/sorgenia.yaml. The password is not saved.

otp.title: Verify Sorgenia login
otp.description: We sent the one-time code to the validated phone {phone}. Enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect Sorgenia
reconfigure.description: Enter your Sorgenia email and the value of the password field in the POST /sorgenia/V5/login Network payload. If it differs from the password typed on the website, use the payload value. API settings are read from /config/sorgenia.yaml. The password is not saved.

error.login_failed: Sorgenia login or OTP request failed. Check the username and password.
error.login_bad_request: Sorgenia rejected the login data (HTTP 400). Check the email and use the password value from the POST /sorgenia/V5/login Network payload, as described in the README.
error.otp_request_bad_request: Sorgenia rejected the OTP request (HTTP 400). Check the validated phone and account data.
error.api_auth_failed: Sorgenia returned HTTP 401/403. Check the login Basic value and API subscription key in /config/sorgenia.yaml.
error.otp_failed: OTP verification failed. Check the code and try again.

abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. The Sorgenia token has been renewed.
